channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Congress might end a ban on mining near the Boundary Waters. Here’s what to know.
item.description: Efforts overturn the ban in Superior National Forest may come to fruition in late February. A rollback could send a lifeline to the Twin Metals proposal in northern Minnesota.

item.title: Jambu the orangutan euthanized at Como Zoo after cancer discovery
item.description: The 40-year-old primate was known for “long calls” that announced his presence and strength.

item.title: American Birkebeiner ends with uncommonly close, crowded finishes
item.description: Cold and snow showed up just in time to fuel a successful Birkie weekend, including a record-breaking course time.

item.title: Neal: Minnesotans should rejoice in glow of Americans’ double Olympic hockey gold
item.description: Both gold medal-winning hockey teams pulled off overtime victories over Canada with heavy contributions from Minnesota players.

item.title: Berry pickers and mushroom hunters may soon have more state guidance
item.description: A special task force tells the Legislature to put foraging on par with hunting and fishing.

item.title: Shooting closes Maplewood Mall
item.description: A non-fatal shooting was reported at the mall Sunday. The mall plans to reopen Monday.

item.title: Reusse: For 1980 gold medalists, 2026 U.S. men’s hockey team stirs up memories
item.description: Those from the “Miracle on Ice” team are big fans of the “Surprise on Ice” team that will bring home the gold from the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: Minnesota and other pension funds invest in private credit. What are the high risk, high reward loans?
item.description: The opaque debt market is growing fast and with little oversight.

item.title: As ICE draws down in Minnesota, data illustrates intensity of its surge here
item.description: Homeland Security’s Operation Metro Surge is on the wane in Minnesota, though crowdsourced data about the frequency and locations where ICE agents have been spotted show they’re far from totally gone.

item.title: ICE detained a Minnesota teen, labeled him an ‘unaccompanied minor,’ and lost him
item.description: The Trump administration is apprehending and designating immigrant kids as “unaccompanied,” even as their parents in the U.S. search for them.
